evidence.result_scope: host-side ABI, root isolation, interpreter, renderer-provider and compiled-SDL-driver verification only

image_layout.read_method: debugfs read-only with byte offset; never mounted, never looped, never written

topology.isolation_rule: a 64-bit root never enters a 32-bit closure and vice versa; each root is judged by the runtime ELFs it exposes

interpreter_runtime.note: the environment records what the official image ships. The field failure that matters for muOS -- a firmware python3 that dies with 'bad marshal data' in its own stdlib -- is a per-case fault, not a property of the shipped binary, and stays covered by the synthetic firmware profile 'muos' plus the python-probe gate.

renderer.note: presence is measured from the image; nothing here initializes video or touches DRM/Mali/framebuffer

sdl.compiled_video_drivers_source: queried from the image's own SDL under qemu user mode; never assumed
